findings.description: The commit message describes what was changed but does not include output from `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npm run lint`, `npm test`, `npm run build`, or `npm run test:e2e`. The plan explicitly requires running all five gates and documenting pass/fail results. Without this evidence, the review cannot confirm: TypeScript compilation succeeds, no ESLint violations were introduced, unit tests still pass, the production build succeeds, or the 32-check e2e suite (320/360/390/414px matrix) still passes.
findings.action: Re-run all five quality gates (`npx tsc --noEmit`, `npm run lint`, `npm test`, `npm run build`, `npm run test:e2e`), capture their output, and provide pass/fail confirmation. If any gate fails, fix the issues before requesting re-review.
